lines: Bernard played 90% of snaps over his last 3 games, up from 75% on the season, but he saw 4.3 targets per game.
He's averaged 4.9 PPR points and 19.0 receiving yards per game over that stretch, with a 17% share of the team's targets.
Wk 11 is at PHI, which allows the 3rd-most PPR points per game to WRs. The coach said the staff will watch rookies for a late-season wall.
